svg.title: Five platform surfaces and the five questions that decide platform scenario items
svg.desc: Cards for plug-ins and custom APIs, Dataverse APIs and SDKs, Azure Functions, cloud flows and custom agents, each answered for when it runs, which identity reaches the data, what happens on failure or repeat, which limit applies and where to look first.
svg.text: Extend Microsoft Power Platform: five surfaces, five questions
Ask these before reading the options
1 When does it run (stage, trigger, schedule, call)?
2 Who reaches the data (user, SYSTEM, app user)?
3 Fails: what if it fails, times out or runs twice?
4 Limit: which number in the stem matters?
5 Look: where would you look first?
Plug-ins and custom APIs
When stage 10 / 20 / 40 in the save; async after commit
Who UserId (run-as), null = SYSTEM, Initiating = caller
Fails sync: all rolls back; async: failed system job
Limit 2 min per operation, aim under 2 s, Depth 8
Look trace log, System Jobs, Plug-ins analytics
Dataverse APIs and SDKs
When when the client calls; background ops later
Who delegated user, or application user + role
Fails 401 token, 403 role, 412 etag, 429 Retry-After
Limit 6,000 requests, 20 min, 52 concurrent / 5 min
Look status and error code, Retry-After, dop hint
Azure Functions
When timer (6-field NCRONTAB, UTC), queue, HTTP
Who managed identity + app user per environment
Fails timer not retried; queue 5 tries, then poison
Limit HTTP answers within 230 s; durable for longer
Look Application Insights, poison queue, status URL
Cloud flows
When after commit; Select columns, Filter rows
Who the connection behind the connection reference
Fails retries 408/429/5xx only; run after; Terminate
Limit Do until 60 / PT1H; loops sequential by default
Look run history, result('Try'), failure alerts
Custom agents
When when the orchestrator calls a tool or an agent
Who user token (Work IQ, client library) or agent ID
Fails approval requests; 400 / 404 / 401–403 errors
Limit preview status, Copilot Credits, Ask 30/min
Look Foundry traces, tool call items, test chat
Karim's lesson 116 falls were all question 2: Entra API permissions taken for Dataverse authorization.
